title: Acceptance probability of a three-variable linear predicate
statement: For any right-hand side $r\in\mathbb{F}_2$, a uniformly random triple of elements of $\mathbb{F}_2$ satisfies the predicate given by the maximum three-variable linear template with right-hand side $r$ with probability $1/2$.
